nodes.label: Claude Code Permission Policy
nodes.rationale: Three-tier allow/ask/deny model: routine local toolchain commands run unattended, mutating or publishing commands prompt, and destructive commands plus reading .env files are hard-denied.

nodes.label: playground Package Manifest
nodes.rationale: Private ESM package; most TanStack dependencies are pinned to `latest` to track the fast-moving pre-release ecosystem, with only Nitro and use-sync-external-store hard-pinned.

nodes.label: #/* Subpath Import Alias
nodes.rationale: Node subpath imports map #/* to ./src/* so runtime resolution matches the TypeScript path alias without a bundler-only alias plugin.

nodes.label: pnpm onlyBuiltDependencies Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Postinstall build scripts are denied by default and explicitly allowlisted for esbuild and lightningcss, limiting arbitrary code execution during install.

nodes.label: TypeScript Bundler-Mode Compiler Options
nodes.rationale: moduleResolution bundler with noEmit and verbatimModuleSyntax defers emit to Vite while strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters and noUncheckedSideEffectImports keep type checking as the primary lint gate.

nodes.label: TypeScript Path Aliases (#/* and @/*)
nodes.rationale: Two aliases (#/* and @/*) both point at ./src/*, giving source files a stable import root regardless of which convention a file uses.

nodes.label: TanStack Intent Skill Registry
nodes.rationale: Machine-readable manifest of guidance commands agents must load before editing files, so that edits follow current TanStack API conventions rather than model memory.

nodes.label: TanStack Devtools Plugin System
nodes.rationale: Devtools shell hosts framework-adapter plugins registered via a plugins prop; max 3 active plugins, Solid.js core plus devtools-ui recommended for multi-framework reuse.

nodes.label: Devtools EventClient Protocol
nodes.rationale: Typed event maps with pluginId auto-prepend namespacing avoid event collisions between libraries; payloads must be serializable, events consolidated and debounced, and emit() guarded in production.

nodes.label: Devtools Vite Plugin Must Be First
nodes.rationale: @tanstack/devtools-vite must be the FIRST plugin in the Vite config so source inspection can attach data-tsd-source markers before other plugins transform the source; supports Vite ^6 || ^7 only.
nodes.norm_label: devtools vite plugin must be first

nodes.label: Router Full Type Inference Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Never cast and never annotate inferred values; use the Register module declaration, `from` narrowing, getRouteApi for code-split files, and addChildren object syntax for TypeScript performance.

nodes.label: Isomorphic-by-Default Execution Model
nodes.rationale: Code is isomorphic unless explicitly bounded; createServerFn/createServerOnlyFn/createClientOnlyFn mark environment boundaries so dead code elimination and import protection can keep server secrets off the client (VITE_ prefix rules).

nodes.label: File-Based Routing in src/routes
nodes.rationale: Routes are plain files under src/routes and the root layout lives in __root.tsx so shared shell markup (HeadContent, Scripts, nav) is declared once and inherited by every route.

nodes.label: Route Loader Data Fetching
nodes.rationale: Loaders run before render so data is resolved at the route level rather than in component effects; chosen alongside TanStack Query as an alternative fetching strategy.

nodes.label: Nitro Generic Server Adapter
nodes.rationale: Nitro is used as a generic adapter so the build emits a self-contained Node server (dist/server/index.mjs) that runs on any Node-compatible host instead of locking the project to one platform preset.

nodes.label: T3Env Type-Safe Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: Environment variables are declared in src/env.mjs and imported via the #/env alias so misspelled or missing vars fail at type-check rather than at runtime.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Styling Setup
nodes.rationale: Tailwind is wired through the @tailwindcss/vite plugin plus a single import in src/styles.css, so removing it is a documented four-step opt-out rather than a rewrite.

nodes.label: Storybook Configure Onboarding Page
nodes.rationale: Default Storybook docs page pointing at styling, mocking/decorators, static assets, autodocs, Chromatic publishing, Figma embedding, testing, a11y and theming guides.

nodes.label: Fuzzy Directory Search in the Create Wizard
nodes.rationale: The directory prompt searches the real tree under src/ instead of asking the user to recall it, because a typo there is the one step of `create` that silently succeeds - writing a fixture into a directory nobody imports from. Matching is subsequence-based rather than substring so an abbreviation like `slgen` finds `src/lib/gen`; adjacency and segment-boundary hits rank highest because that is what a person typing an abbreviation means.
nodes.norm_label: fuzzy directory search in the create wizard

nodes.label: Anchored New Directory Creation
nodes.rationale: A typed name that matches nothing is created inside the row currently highlighted rather than at the cwd, so navigating to a location and typing a child name does the obvious thing. A path containing a `/` is taken literally instead, which is the escape hatch out of the highlighted location. The directory is created lazily at write time, so abandoning the wizard at a later prompt leaves no empty directory behind.
